question: Who is the first Indian woman to have won a Grammy Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tanvi Shah.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tanvi Shah won the Grammy Award for Best Song Written for Visual Media in 2009 for co-writing the Spanish lyrics for the song "Jai Ho" from the movie Slumdog Millionaire.**
 
• **She is a singer-songwriter, composer, and music producer from Chennai, Tamil Nadu.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asha Bhosle is a legendary playback singer who has won several awards including the National Film Award and the Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award.**
 
• **Anuradha Paudwal and Alka Yagnik **are also renowned **playback singers **in the Indian music industry but they have not won a Grammy Award either.
